name: thermfm
_comment: Therm-FM steady HotSpot release: <dir>/input.mat (N,P,L,H,W; channel 0 = volumetric power density; the release does not document the other channels, so only channel 0 is mapped) and <dir>/output.mat (N,L,H,W; values look like kelvin but the release does not state units, so units are left unspecified). MATLAB v7.3 (h5py order). No split is published with the files.
